verdict.rationale: An OpenAPI 3.1 spec is confirmed to exist at docs.browser-use.com/cloud/openapi/v4.json (21 paths), which could power an interactive reference, and docs contain many concrete code snippets (e.g. client.runs.create calls). However there is no evidence of an actual interactive 'try it out' style API explorer with runnable examples in-browser — earlier probes even found openapi.json/swagger.json 404 at conventional paths, suggesting no dedicated interactive docs UI was found. Missing for 10: confirmed interactive Swagger/Redoc-style explorer UI, evidence of in-page 'run this request' functionality, independent user confirmation of using it.
